2609.33955.title: Designing Reliable LLM-as-a-Judge Measurement Systems for Multi-Turn Business Agents
2609.33955.paper_summary: Many LLM-as-a-judge evaluations score fixed outputs under a fixed task definition. Production multi-turn business agents instead require a maintained measurement system: correctness depends on business-specific facts and procedures, outcomes emerge across turns, and failures must be attributed to either agent capability or missing business knowledge before they are actionable. We present an integrated methodology spanning evaluation specification, modular LLM judges, intent-preserving user simulation, and human-in-the-loop governance. The specification defines conversation-level end states and actionable failure ownership. Atomic judges share versioned evidence and feed an explicit aggregation graph. The simulator is released only after task-preservation and stability checks. Independent human audits estimate measurement fidelity, renew tiered reference sets, and route disagreements to label correction, guideline revision, or judge improvement. Production studies show that system-level fidelity improved across repeated audits, that human reviewers and automated judges improved together under the shared feedback loop, and that their combined workflow had the strongest descriptive performance in both reported task-completion settings. Because the studies are observational and the human reference itself required revision, these findings demonstrate operational usefulness rather than causal or universal superiority. The contribution is a practical framework for making multi-turn agent measurement reliable, actionable, and maintainable as the evaluated system and its evidence evolve.
2609.33955.paper_summary_zh: 許多 LLM 作為評判的評估在固定任務定義下對固定輸出進行評分。生產多回合商業代理則需要一個維持的測量系統：正確性依賴於特定於業務的事實和程序，結果在多回合中產生，失敗必須歸因於代理能力或缺失的業務知識，才能採取行動。我們提出了一種綜合方法，涵蓋評估規範、模組化 LLM 評判、保持意圖的用戶模擬和人機協作治理。該規範定義了對話級別的最終狀態和可行的失敗歸屬。原子評判共享版本化證據並提供明確的聚合圖。模擬器僅在任務保持和穩定性檢查後釋出。獨立的人類審核評估測量的真實性，更新分層參考集，並將分歧引導至標籤修正、指導方針修訂或評判改進。生產研究顯示，系統級的真實性在重複審核中有所改善，人類審核者和自動評判在共享反饋循環下共同進步，且他們的結合工作流程在報告的任務完成設置中表現出最強的描述性性能。由於這些研究是觀察性的，而人類參考本身需要修訂，因此這些發現展示了操作上的實用性，而非因果或普遍的優越性。這一貢獻是一個實用框架，使多回合代理的測量在被評估系統及其證據演變過程中變得可靠、可行和可維護。
2609.33955.author: Kaiwen Luo et.al.
